sources.title: The Rigveda: The Earliest Religious Poetry of India
sources.inspected: Introduction excerpts, printed pp. 1–15 and 13–22; targeted readings pp. 4–6, 9–10, 13–18. Not the whole book or all hymn translations.
observations: Approximate dating of surviving hymn composition is separated from older poetic conventions.
Poet patronage, bardic training and collection supply mechanisms for sophisticated composition.
Textual preservation is distinguished from loss or reinterpretation of older meaning.
The authors assess the later Pururavas–Urvasi background as a distortion or misunderstanding of parts of RV 10.95.
sources.rights: Copyrighted excerpts on a university teaching site. Local witnesses only; own paraphrases and locators tracked. Two overlapping PDFs are one source, not independent evidence.

sources.title: RV 10.95 Purūrávas og Urváśī
sources.type: academic teaching edition of selected Sanskrit text and philological notes
sources.inspected: RV 10.95.1–5, Sanskrit, padapatha and selected Jamison–Brereton translation with teaching notes. No claim to have critically edited the whole hymn.
observations: Dialogue and difficult imagery are present in the older verses.
Verse 3 contains imagery involving flashing and a lamb's bleating; parsing and reference are disputed in the notes.
sources.rights: Mixed edition, teaching notes and modern translation; acquired page local-only. Source attributions retained.

sources.title: SATAPATHA-BRAHMANA 11
sources.type: reference Sanskrit electronic text; bracketed numbering mechanically added
sources.inspected: Header and SB 11.5.1.1–17; checked Sanskrit locators and narrative/technical names alongside Eggeling. Not a new critical edition or independent manuscript witness.
observations: Named narrative participants and quoted dialogue coexist with prose framing.
The ending gives alternative named-wood configurations for upper and lower arani before prescribing one configuration.
sources.rights: Header defers copyright and terms to source file. Unresolved source rights; raw page local-only.

sources.title: The Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa, Part V
sources.series: Sacred Books of the East, Volume XLIV
sources.type: historical primary-text translation with philological footnotes
sources.inspected: SB 11.5.1.1–17 and notes, printed pp. 68–74 in the electronic witness.
observations: SB 11.5.1.1–4 supplies a marriage condition, theft of lambs, lightning and separation.
SB 11.5.1.6–10 inserts older dialogue into the new frame.
SB 11.5.1.13–17 leads to fire production and a prescribed arani configuration.
sources.rights: Historical translation; acquired web wrapper and entire page remain local. Own paraphrases and bibliographic metadata tracked.
